handoff_instructions: M3-T17 done. Added packages/domain: `ops_case.resolve` permission (owner/office_admin/manager) and `decideOpsCaseInput`/`DecideOpsCaseInput` schema (decision resolved|dismissed, note required to resolve). Added packages/core: `decideOpsCase` in services/ops.ts (tenant-side resolve/dismiss of an open ops case, human-actor-only, row-locked, idempotent replay, ConflictError on a conflicting re-decision, event + audit, mirrors decideDraftRecord/decideBillableOpportunity's authority pattern but updates ops_cases, which already has all client privileges revoked by 0002_m1_foundation.sql so no new migration was needed) and `listOpenBillableOpportunities` in services/billable-opportunities.ts (gated on billable.decide, status='open'). Wired both into apps/web: /inbox now shows a 'Billable opportunities' section (approve/dismiss via decideBillableOpportunity, already built in M3-T15 -- never a direct status update) and a 'Clarifications' section (open ops cases, i.e. status not in resolved/closed, from listOrgOpsCases; resolve/dismiss via the new decideOpsCase) between the existing approvals and tasks sections, following the existing ApprovalCard pattern (evaluateApprovalDecision + DENIAL_TEXT for billables, a plain resolve/dismiss form for clarifications). Added server actions decideBillableOpportunityAction and decideOpsCaseAction to apps/web/src/app/actions/tenant.ts. Tests added: packages/core/test/ops-access.test.ts (decideOpsCase: role eligibility, note-required-to-resolve, replay/conflict, forbidden actors, tenant scoping) and packages/core/test/billable-opportunities.test.ts (listOpenBillableOpportunities: org scoping, drops decided rows, forbidden for managers). format/lint/typecheck/test all pass; `next build` succeeds (apps/web). Next: M3-T18 "M3 acceptance test" (kind: acceptance) -- automated end-to-end test of the MILESTONES.md acceptance input through the workflow with the fixture extractor.
